run_examine_env: run the examine_env CLI to visualize a gym environment's policy behavior onscreen or offscreen
run_examine_env_random: run the examine_env CLI with no policy to explore a gym environment using random actions
run_examine_env_save_paths: run the examine_env CLI to evaluate a policy and save rollout paths as pickle files
run_examine_env_plot_paths: run the examine_env CLI to evaluate a policy and generate 2D plots of rollout paths
run_examine_env_offscreen: run the examine_env CLI to evaluate a policy with offscreen rendering and save outputs
